name: components-community-flip-card
blurb: Profile card that flips on hover/click to reveal stats and social links.
description: A card displaying front (name, image, bio) and back (stats, social links) sides. Flips on hover (desktop) or click (touch). Shows following, followers, and posts. Includes social media links.
use_when: Team pages, community showcases, or profile networks where flip-reveal adds engagement.
avoid_when: When all info should be immediately visible — flipping hides content.
a11y: Flip mechanism should be keyboard-accessible. Social links are proper anchors.
